routes.title: Own Plate Theory
routes.lane: food-denial ritual / being known / extra plate as care receipt
routes.universal_relationship_truth: Some people say they do not want food when what they really want is to be included without making it a whole thing.
routes.aachu_spark: She says no plate, then watches his food and steals one small bite like the plate personally invited her.
routes.zuv_active_role: He does not lecture, tease cruelly, or force food; he quietly keeps an extra small plate or best bite ready because he knows the ritual.
routes.proof_engine: No plate requested, eye-line to his food, hand reaches, second plate appears, both pretend this was not predictable.
routes.share_thesis: Love is sometimes knowing the appetite behind the sentence.

routes.title: Which One Was Never A Question
routes.lane: outfit choice / being noticed / answer hidden in her face
routes.universal_relationship_truth: "Which one?" is sometimes not a request for a choice; it is a request to be seen.
routes.aachu_spark: She cycles through outfits, insists she is confused, but keeps touching the one she already loves.
routes.zuv_active_role: He notices the smile and picks the one she had chosen before asking.
routes.proof_engine: Mirror, two outfits on bed, her hand returns to one dupatta, his answer follows her expression.
routes.share_thesis: Love learns the answer before the question finishes.

routes.title: Last Reel Pending
routes.lane: bedtime scroll / charger care / not parenting the other person
routes.universal_relationship_truth: "Last reel" is not a time estimate in marriage.
routes.aachu_spark: She says one more reel while her eyes are already sleepy.
routes.zuv_active_role: He plugs in the phone and shifts the pillow without turning it into a lecture.
routes.proof_engine: Phone at low battery, sleepy scrolling, charger movement, lights softened.
routes.share_thesis: Love knows when to protect the rest you are pretending not to need.

routes.title: Fan Speed Treaty
routes.lane: one room, two climates / comfort negotiation
routes.universal_relationship_truth: Marriage is two weather systems sharing one remote.
routes.aachu_spark: She wants air but not that much air, blanket but not full blanket, fan but not speed three.
routes.zuv_active_role: He adjusts the fan, moves seats, and makes the room livable for both.
routes.proof_engine: Remote, fan, blanket edge, two body temperatures, one tiny compromise.
routes.share_thesis: Love is the climate both people can survive in.

routes.title: Ready But Not Ready
routes.lane: doorway return / forgotten item loop / patience without stereotype
routes.universal_relationship_truth: "Ready" sometimes means the leaving process has begun, not ended.
routes.aachu_spark: She reaches the door, then returns for earrings, lip balm, phone, or one last thing.
routes.zuv_active_role: He holds the door and keeps the keys without making her feel foolish.
routes.proof_engine: Door half-open, shoes on, keys in hand, one more object remembered.
routes.share_thesis: Love waits for the whole person, not only the schedule.

routes.title: The Screenshot Translator
routes.lane: private meme language / reels become relationship shorthand
routes.universal_relationship_truth: Some couples do not say feelings directly; they send one screenshot and expect a full reading.
routes.aachu_spark: She sends a tiny reference and expects him to know the whole emotional context.
routes.zuv_active_role: He decodes it correctly and answers the feeling, not only the image.
routes.proof_engine: Phone glow, shared look, small handwritten labels instead of UI-heavy screenshots.
routes.share_thesis: Love becomes fluent in the things you do not fully explain.

routes.title: Medicine Water Without Drama
routes.lane: health care / quiet reminder / softness after stubbornness
routes.universal_relationship_truth: "I'm fine" sometimes needs water placed beside it.
routes.aachu_spark: She insists she is okay while clearly tired or under the weather.
routes.zuv_active_role: He keeps water and medicine near her without making a speech.
routes.proof_engine: Glass, medicine strip, blanket or pillow, a quiet check-in.
routes.share_thesis: Love hears the body under the brave face.

routes.title: The Third Thing
routes.lane: leaving the house / forgotten essentials / lift wait
routes.universal_relationship_truth: Some people leave the house in chapters.
routes.aachu_spark: She remembers a new essential only after everyone is already near the lift.
routes.zuv_active_role: He waits with the door/lift/key and absorbs the time pressure lightly.
routes.proof_engine: Lift button, keys, one shoe, phone, small bag, repeated turn-back.
routes.share_thesis: Love makes room for the chapters.
